source_text:
3.27 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ· περὶ σκολοπένδρασ Η σκολόπενδρα
μεῖζον μὲν ἀδικεῖ· σὺ δὲ μέρος τι τῆς ἀντιδότου θηριακῆς ἐπιχρίσας ἴασαι τὸν
κεκνισμένον τόπον. Ἀσφοδέλου δὲ καρπὸς καὶ τὰ ἄνθη σὺν οἴνῳ πινόμενα
σκολοπένδρας εἰσὶν ἀντίπαλα, συκῆς τε ὄλυνθοι μετ' οἴνου καὶ ὀρόβου
καταπλασσόμενοι παύουσι τὴν ἀλγηδόνα.
pass_a_gloss: 3.27 Of-the-same: about a-scolopendra. The scolopendra greater yes it-wrongs; you but a-part some of-the-antidote theriac having-smeared-on heal the having-been-stung place. Of-asphodel but fruit and the flowers with wine being-drunk of-a-scolopendra are counters, of-a-fig both olunthoi with wine and vetch being-plastered they-stop the pain.
pass_b_english: Of the same: about a scolopendra. The scolopendra does greater harm; but you, having smeared on some part of the theriac antidote, heal the stung place. Fruit of asphodel and the flowers, drunk with wine, are counters of a scolopendra; and fig-olunthoi with wine and vetch, being plastered, stop the pain.

choices.why: ἀδικεῖ is the scolopendra's harm, not a moral injustice.
rejected: it wrongs more as a person

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
